default_routing.rationale: ORIGINAL v2 rationale: cheapest model in our data that achieved gold/silver/bronze (E003). HOWEVER as of 2026-06-04 the v3 evidence has SUBSTANTIALLY UPDATED this picture: (a) detecting-insults — sonnet-all and all single/dual-role opus configs INVALID submission (E019/E020/E026); only opus-everywhere works ($341 gold). Override added: tasks.detecting-insults.default = opus-4-8 (E035). (b) spooky-author — E045 LLM agent predicted opus-all needed; E046 cli.py confirmed sonnet-all → INVALID submission ($7.84). So sonnet-all is now PROVEN insufficient on 2 of 3 known text-classification members. Use the agentic router (router_strategy=llm + inspect_data=True) for new text-classification tasks; do NOT trust the family default.

detecting-insults-in-social-commentary.notes: v3 SCHEMA GATE: 10 single/dual-role routings (haiku-all, sonnet-all, opus-aggregator, opus-coder, ...) ALL produced invalid_submission (missing 'Comment' column); only opus-everywhere yields a valid gold submission. Matches policy.json. SUPERSEDES the old E001 haiku-all override, which was v2-only — the v3 splitter/evaluator/selector surface introduced a schema gate haiku cannot clear. Do NOT downgrade this task on cost grounds: a cheaper routing forfeits the whole run (invalid submission = zero result).
